title: Disappearing messages: timed delete, per-chat expiry, burn-on-read, delete-after-read
description: Mark 2026-11-21: build all of it now. (1) sender timed delete: JMAP Chat senderExpiresAt <-> mimi-content expires, both ways; the store deletes at that time everywhere (tombstone). (2) per-chat local messageExpirySeconds. (3) burnOnRead and expiresAfterReadSeconds via a mimid-only mimiExtensions entry (INVENTED), honoured only by mimid recipients; read = JMAP readAt, and on IRC 'shown to the IRC client'. Plus a WG question on carrying (3) in mimi-content (Mark's OK before posting).
